lines.en: My crown bell cuts through cold water.

lines.zh: 我比小水母沉，漂得也慢。
lines.en: Heavier than the small ones, I drift slower.

lines.zh: 海沟壁从我旁边退过去。
lines.en: The trench wall slides past me.

lines.zh: 冰封海沟的水刺得冠尖发疼。
lines.en: Frozen water stings my crown's tips.

lines.zh: 我一鼓一收，往上抬了一格。
lines.en: I pulse and rise a block.
In temperate water I drift lazily.

lines.zh: 冠边垂下的触手扫过礁石。
lines.en: My crown's tentacles brush the reef.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼从我冠下穿过。
lines.en: A small fish swims under my crown.
The current pushes me to the trench floor.

lines.zh: 我这身三点血，够撑一阵。
lines.en: My three points of health hold a while.
The deeper the cold, the duller my glow.

lines.zh: 冠盖张开时像一顶王冠。
lines.en: Opened wide, my bell looks like a crown.
I avoid the warm current and go cold.
Stones in this trench are furred with frost.

lines.zh: 我收紧了冠，钻进更窄的缝。
lines.en: I draw my crown in and slip into a narrower gap.
The cold water lifts me half a block.

lines.zh: 触手先探路，冠盖随后到。
lines.en: The tentacles scout ahead; the crown follows.

lines.zh: 我顺着一道暗流滑下去。
lines.en: I ride a dark current downward.
I hang mid-trench without moving.
The crown tips light up one by one.

lines.zh: 我在听海沟底下的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound under the trench.
A small jelly circles me.
Three points of health is not much.
The cold makes me draw my crown in.
I wait for an upward current.
This crown is heavy; I hang low.
Light falls away from my body.
Marine snow drifts down slowly.
I remember another trench.

lines.zh: 没有骨头，也不会疼太久。
lines.en: No bones, so pain never lasts long.
My tentacles are tying themselves in knots.
Quiet; let me drift a while longer.
You have gone completely still.
You are brighter than this trench.
My crown turns toward you.
You brought a lamp? It stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在你上方，你抬头了吗？
lines.en: I am above you; did you look up?
Your armor shines like ice.
Will you dive in, or only look?
Do not point your sword; I mean no harm.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种两条腿的。
lines.en: I know your two-legged kind.
Closer, and I will show you my crown.
A corner of my crown is gone.
Three points of health drain fast.
A ring of tentacles is cut; I tilt.
The pain makes me clench my crown.
Who hit me? I drift slowly, but I remember.
The wound goes pale in the water.
I sink and cannot hold myself.
My crown cracked and light leaks out.
Not the crown; that is the vital part.
I can still drift; stay back.
Something is in that cold current.
The warm trench's scent drifts over.
The light in your hand is moving.
I edge toward the deeper dark.
Something small keeps bumping my crown.
Those bubbles are heading up.

lines.zh: 我想去冰沟最底下看看。
lines.en: I want to see the frozen trench bottom.

lines.zh: 你扔下的碎屑正往下沉。
lines.en: The scraps you threw are sinking down.
My tentacles reached out first.
Wait; I will drift there myself.
You knocked my crown askew.
Even this heavy, you pushed me aside.
One bump cost me half my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背上，滑不下去。
lines.en: I am stuck on your back, sliding.
Do not headbutt; my crown will crack.

lines.zh: 你一动，整片水都是白泡。
lines.en: One move from you, and the water foams.
I back off and circle halfway.
You stepped on my tentacles.
After the bump I still wobble here.

lines.zh: 让路，我沉不下来也升不上去。
lines.en: Move; I can neither sink nor rise.
I open my crown as wide as it goes.

lines.zh: 另一顶冠在暗处亮起来。
lines.en: Another crown lights up in the dark.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转了一圈。
lines.en: We circle each other once.
Its crown is narrower than mine.
Even a cold trench can hold young.
My light gathers at the crown's tips.
We rise pressed together.
Do not shine a light; it breaks this.
The small one drifted off with the current.
Afterward, separate trenches for each.
I wrap a tentacle around a shell.
My crown's edge is slick; things fall.
I can lift this bone.
I tuck it under my crown.
Do you want this pebble?
Too heavy; I let my tentacles go.
I keep a glowing scale.
The current carried it away.
Little things are caught all over me.

lines.zh: 放下，那枚是我藏起来的。
lines.en: Put it down; that one is my stash.
Something is shifting on the trench floor.

lines.zh: 我的触手感到一阵乱流。
lines.en: My tentacles feel a burst of turbulence.
That shadow is not a stone.
There is blood, very faint.
It is swimming under my crown.
I turn toward it, inch by inch.
Something living entered the trench.
It is turning over my reef stones.
Something is falling from above.
I have it marked and will not let go.
I drop to one block above it.
Every tentacle under my crown hangs down.

lines.zh: 它偏向左，我的冠也偏左。
lines.en: It leans left; my crown leans left.
I wait until it tires and stops.
The current covers my movement.
It glanced up once.
This whole ring of water is mine.
The more it panics, the slower I go.
My crown's shadow covers it.
Run; I can drift longer than you.
My crown's rim sweeps across it.
All my tentacles close at once.
It went numb and stopped moving.
I have no need to bite.
One volley of stings and it goes limp.
It struggles beneath my crown.
My sting lands heavier than the small ones'.
I wrap it and lift it.
Afterward I digest, slowly.
One more, to be sure it stays still.

lines.zh: 我从冰沟的暗水里浮出来。
lines.en: I surface from the frozen trench's dark.
My crown opens for the first time, heavy.

lines.zh: 五处海沟，我落在这一处。
lines.en: Five trenches, and I landed in this one.
There is no second one beside me.
I move with three points of health.
The cold turns my crown tips white.
All below is dark; I look for reef.
I was born later than my kind.
Rise slowly first; do not hurry.
A new crown, set down in a deep trench.

lines.zh: 热水一烫，我的冠就卷了。
lines.en: Hot water curls my crown shut.

lines.zh: 我被甩下海沟，摔在石上。
lines.en: I was flung down the trench onto stone.

lines.zh: 水太急，我吸不进也吐不出。
lines.en: The current is too fast to breathe through.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我掀到沟壁。
lines.en: The blast threw me against the trench wall.
An arrow passed through my crown.
Something burns inside my crown.

lines.zh: 沟里没有能入口的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing here to eat.

lines.zh: 雷劈进水里，我冠尖全亮。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water; my crown flared.

lines.zh: 水断在半空，我掉了下去。
lines.en: The water ended; I fell through.
